jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering Management
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers focused on delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that improve how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive experiences, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer plays an important role in shaping the quality, reliability, and long-term success of our products.

About The Team

The Service Operations Business Unit brings together IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and CMDB capabilities on the ServiceNow Platform. This product engineering organization builds the software that helps customers deliver resilient, intelligent, and efficient enterprise services.

The Service Operations product portfolio connects incident, request, fulfillment, infrastructure visibility, service mapping, trusted configuration data, automation, and AIOps into a unified operating model. By combining service delivery with operational intelligence and trusted operational context, these products help customers move toward proactive, AI-assisted, and increasingly self-healing operations at enterprise scale.

Together, these capabilities help customers modernize how they deliver and operate services, improve reliability, reduce manual effort, and drive measurable productivity outcomes on a single platform.

What You Get To Do In This Role

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams that architect and build assistive and autonomous AI-native products to usher customers (IT departments using our IT service and operations management applications) into an agentic-first era. The work will span large-scale distributed systems, data ingestion, context creation and utilization, agentic harnesses, cost optimization, and agentic feedback loops to ensure value realization for our customers.

This role requires people leadership, thought leadership, deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a keen understanding of the scientific method to ship and refine real product through iterative experimentation. You will be accountable for the growth, health, and delivery outcomes of your teams.

Responsibilities Include

Lead and grow the engineering teams responsible for assigned problem areas within ITSM/ITOM products, working with product and engineering leaders to understand blockers and opportunities around AI-native evolution and value realization.
Own technical strategy and delivery for your teams. Set architectural direction, hold the bar on quality and reliability, and stay close enough to the work to validate hypotheses through evidence, not theory.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers, tech leads, and managers. Build inclusive, high-performing teams with clear career paths and durable ownership.
Drive evidence-based decision-making: formulate hypotheses, run experiments, measure outcomes, and use data to guide architectural decisions and product direction.
Lead the evolution of current solutions toward AI-native capabilities—identifying where agentic patterns, data utilization, or autonomous workflows can unlock customer value—and translate those recommendations into staffed, executable work.
Identify and address value realization gaps in agentic products that exist but aren’t delivering expected outcomes. Diagnose root causes (architecture, UX, data quality, feedback loops, cost) and direct targeted improvements.
Establish architecture patterns, engineering standards, and operating rhythms specific to your problem domain. Document tradeoffs, rationale, and implementation guidance to help teams move faster and make consistent decisions.
Collaborate across ITSM/ITOM engineering teams to share learnings, validate approaches, and accelerate adoption of patterns that work.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success — aligning on roadmap and release readiness, meeting security and compliance requirements, and feeding field and customer signal back into engineering priorities.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

15+ years of related engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams (including managers or team leads), or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, enterprise platforms, workflow systems, data-intensive products, integration frameworks, or cloud-scale infrastructure.
Deep understanding of system design for scale, reliability, observability, fault tolerance, data quality, security, and production readiness.
Strong technical depth in Java, Python, or similar programming languages.
Proven ability to define technical direction, influence architecture across teams, and translate ambiguous product strategy into executable engineering plans.
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineers and engineering leaders, and managing performance, career growth, and team health.
Ability to lead through formal authority and technical credibility alike, building alignment across peer engineering, Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.
Strong judgment in balancing long-term architecture with pragmatic execution, customer impact, engineering velocity, and business priorities.
Experience mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and building reusable patterns that create leverage across teams.
Experience with AI-powered products, automation platforms, AI-assisted workflows, or agentic systems is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about AI-assisted enterprise workflows, including data quality, workflow correctness, evaluation, observability, safety controls, and human-in-the-loop review.
Experience with enterprise service management, IT operations, CMDB, discovery, service mapping, AIOps, observability, workflow automation, endpoint management, or operational intelligence is a strong plus.
Experience working with large-scale enterprise customers, production systems, and complex migration or modernization efforts is a plus.
Why Join Us
Shape the AI-native future of the Service Operations Business Unit product portfolio on the ServiceNow Platform.
Build and lead the teams delivering foundational product and platform capabilities that help enterprises deliver, operate, automate, and continuously improve services at scale.
Define how AI agents, automation, operational data, and human workflows come together to create safer, more reliable, and more productive enterprise operations.
Collaborate with teams that value craftsmanship, quality, innovation, accountability, and meaningful customer impact.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. RBC Capital Markets Global Research is a leading provider of innovative, data-driven insights to engage clients and guide investment decisions. Our research reaches across a universe of companies and multiple asset classes, leveraging deep expertise combined with advanced data science techniques.

We are seeking an experienced Director of Research Technology to lead our research technology organization, responsible for directing technology activities and initiatives that power our research business. You will drive the modernization of our technology infrastructure, streamline research workflows for business users, and architect scalable, cloud-native solutions that enable our research teams to deliver innovative insights at scale.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Partner closely with senior research leaders, business stakeholders, and product teams to translate business strategy into a modern, resilient technology platform.
Lead and mentor a multi-disciplinary team including full-stack developers, data engineers, project managers, and business analysts, fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on delivery excellence and continuous improvement.

Design and oversee the development of software and pipelines that support the complete research lifecycle from analyst ideation and content authoring, compliance, to publication and external distribution via our client-facing portal.

Demonstrated experience successfully leading and developing technology teams of 15+ members across multiple disciplines.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Specialty Access & Affordability value stream is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the FastAuth team. FastAuth is central to how we move specialty prescriptions through prior authorization faster, reducing the time between a prescription being written and a patient starting therapy.

This is a role for a leader who manages significant complexity and can carry multiple major workstreams at once. You will own delivery, team health, and technical direction for FastAuth, and you will operate as a peer to the other engineering leaders in the value stream on decisions that reach beyond your own team. You will lead a group of skilled engineers working across React front ends, .NET services, and event-driven integrations on Azure, on a team that ships continuously and owns what it builds.

What You'll Do

Delivery and execution

Plan and execute across multiple workstreams, setting goals at the right altitude and holding the team accountable to them
Prioritize investment across your portfolio of projects and refocus effort when results are not moving the business forward
Run efficient operating cadences within SAFe, including PI planning.
Unblock the team by addressing root causes rather than symptoms
Ensure delivery results do not come at the expense of long-term growth, retention, or psychological safety

Technical and strategic direction

Define a vision for FastAuth that aligns to value stream and company priorities, and bring engineers and cross-functional partners along with it
Partner with architects and staff engineers on design decisions across TypeScript, React, .NET, Azure, and event-driven architecture
Resolve misalignment with partner teams and stakeholders who hold different goals
Serve as a steady presence through change, and coach the team through complexity and ambiguity

Team and talent

Attract, hire, and retain a diverse and talented engineering team, with an eye on long-term org health rather than the immediate opening
Interview and assess senior candidates, and keep your team calibrated as interviewers
Hold the team to clear performance expectations, motivating high performers and turning around low performers
Grow careers deliberately by matching development opportunities to individual goals and offering next-level work to those ready for it
Structure the team so the right people are in the right roles, and plan headcount for sustained success

Collaboration and culture

Break down silos across engineering, product, design, and quality, and influence toward the best outcome for the business rather than the local optimization
Build deep cross-functional relationships, facilitate the right conversations, and settle disagreements by managing competing viewpoints
Disagree and commit when that is what moves a critical priority forward
Remove barriers to inclusion, surface cultural issues proactively, and follow through when something is off
Write and speak with clarity, tailoring the message to the audience, and share information so the right people stay aligned

Priority will be given to candidates who reside in the Columbus, OH metropolitan area.

We are unable to provide sponsorhip for this role presently or in the future

Minimum Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience, plus typically 10+ years of relevant professional experience including 4+ years of engineering management experience.

Critical Skills

4+ years leading software engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development
Track record delivering multiple concurrent workstreams with real business impact
Technical foundation strong enough to be credible in design discussions on modern web stacks and cloud platforms, ideally TypeScript, React, .NET, and Azure
Working understanding of event-driven architecture and the tradeoffs it introduces
Experience operating in a scaled agile environment, SAFe or equivalent, including planning across teams
Data-driven approach to delivery health, including flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time, and predictability
Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of AI tooling in engineering workflows
Ability to resolve cross-team misalignment directly, without routing every disagreement through escalation
Clear written and verbal communication that works for both engineers and executives

Additional Skills (Preferred)

Healthcare applications, particularly EHR integrations
Prior authorization, pharmacy, or payer domain experience
FHIR standard, SMART on FHIR integrations, and healthcare data exchange
Experience leading other people managers or building a leadership bench
Experience scaling a team through significant growth, transition, or restructuring
Contributions to engineering communities of practice, internal or external

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Work Environment

Hybrid, based out of the Columbus, Ohio office. Regular collaboration across time zones with distributed team members and partners.

jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Building on The Aerospace Corporation's reputation as a trusted, impartial advisor with integrity and dedication to mission success, the Civil Systems Group (CSG) combines deep technical expertise with market-leading innovation to help our customers solve complex systems engineering and integration challenges. CSG is organized by core customer-facing lines of business to manage and grow programs within NASA, NOAA, and the NNSA, while extending our capabilities to other civilian federal government agencies fully integrated within Aerospace rules, regulations, processes, values, and behaviors.

We are looking for an Enterprise Engineering Systems Director
(Systems Director – Systems and Digital Engineering)
. As a Systems Director in the Civil Systems Group within Defense, you will provide leadership, planning and direction to an experienced team of engineers and work closely with Engineering Technical Managers to support the mission area of the Department of Energy (DOE) National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) Office of Defense Programs (DP). You will lead and manage your team to accomplish systems engineering/analysis to various Defense Program tasks in support of our Nation. You will mentor your team to leverage Aerospace’s vast network of subject matter experts to bring innovative solutions to NNSA’s hardest problems. Additionally, you will look to identify new opportunities/challenges to leverage Aerospace capabilities to apply to our NNSA customer.

This is a full-time position based in Albuquerque, NM, Crystal City, VA, Colorado Springs, CO, or El Segundo, CA which requires a minimum of 4 days/week onsite work.

What You’ll Be Doing

Work closely with Principal Director and the rest of the management team to lead and manage Aerospace Enterprise Engineering team members with the challenging issues Aerospace is tackling for Defense Programs within the National Nuclear Security Administration.
Supports establishment of the Enterprise Engineering organization's objectives/goals with Principal Director and communicate them to your subordinates and interfacing organizations.
Provide strategic leadership and conducts activities consistent with corporate policies/practices, goals, and objectives.
Participates with higher management in determining the organization's structure and staff including resource needs (budget planning and allocation of resources).
Reports the organization's activities, progress, and achievements through written and oral reports to management, subordinates, and customers.
Coordinates work activities within the organization; monitors workload, work progress, and schedules; ensures completion of organization's work assignments within cost and schedule guidelines.
Seeks and identifies opportunities for additional, expanded, and new business and assists Sr. management in evaluating and pursuing new possibilities.
Cooperates and communicates frequently with customers to coordinate and report work progress, issues, and results.
Conducts staff performance reviews and recommends performance improvement, career development, salary, and promotion actions; establishes staffing needs; advises reassignments, training, transfers, and other staff deployments; and assists other supervisors in evaluating and assigning staff.
Directs technical group performing engineering design, analysis, or other research and development activities.
Lead from the front to influence customers to field more integrated solutions.

What You Need to be Successful - Systems Director – Systems Engineering and Digital Engineering

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, or another appropriate technical discipline
12 or more years of progressively responsible professional engineering/scientific experience
Experience in a managerial/leadership role with proven ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of contractors, customers, and corporate staff
Demonstrated networking, teaming, management, and leadership skills within a program office or matrixed technical organization, building and leading project teams, formulating task plans, ensuring product quality, and effectively interacting with customers.
Proven technical credibility across a broad set of systems engineering topics, and a deep understanding of the engineering of complex systems
Experience working with U.S. government agencies such as DOE/NNSA and DoD
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, organizational, written, and oral communication skills
Availability to travel domestically, up to 25% of the time
This position requires a current and active Top Secret or Q security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

Advanced degree in engineering or math with specific experience in Systems/Digital Engineering
Familiarity with the DOE and NNSA National Laboratories in the Defense Programs Arena
Knowledge of the Aerospace Engineering and Technology Group (ETG) skills and capabilities
Demonstrated ability to create solutions to address national security needs

LEGO Digital Play
will bring the LEGO brand into digital entertainment in new, innovative, and wholly-owned ways. Our mission is to ensure the LEGO Brand remains as powerfully a part of children’s lives in the coming decades as it has ever been. We aim to reach every kid on the planet, their parents, and adult fans of LEGO—and provide them with meaningful, magical, and playful new experiences.

We are at the earliest phases of this new company, offering a unique opportunity to build a new entity for the world's most beloved and trusted brand. Our culture is open, collaborative, intellectually rigorous, and creatively vibrant.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the architecture and development of a consumer-facing, living application that is a key component of a broader initiative under development at LEGO Digital Play. Your job is to lead technical decision-making and build a highly collaborative engineering environment built on communication, trust, and clear ownership and accountability. Although you will manage a small team of engineers, this is a “hands-on” role—at least, initially—requiring you to write code alongside your reports.

You will work closely with game designers, product managers, UX professionals, and marketers to guide sound, “future proof” development of the application and to continually ship new features.

This is a Hybrid role requiring 2-3 days per month in the office as well as occasional travel.

This role requires a strong analytical thinker with a passion for data analysis and a firm grasp of the product development process. Strong communication, leadership, and management skills are also a must.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership: Lead an engineering organization responsible for developing the digital/app component of a physical/digital hybrid product line.
Architecture and Future Proofing: Design durable and evolvable architecture capable of supporting the broader product line for years to come while minimizing tech debt.
Communication and Documentation: Ensure decisions are communicated appropriately and the work on the application is appropriately documented and accessible to stakeholders.
Product Planning: Assist the Director of Product Management in prioritizing features and sprint tasks.
Cross-Group Collaboration: Partner with the game designers, product managers, and UX professionals to craft a tightly integrated experience.
Management: Manage a small team of software engineers.
Problem Solving & Decision-Making: dentify challenges early and drive resolution—either directly or through escalation with clear recommendations.

Required Qualifications:

Experience in game development and technical leadership with work on multiple shipped titles.
Familiarity with cross-platform development, specifically the iOS, Android and Web platforms.
Experience with Games-as-a-Service architecture.
Fluency with scrum and/or similar project management methodologies.
Demonstrated success building and managing a small team.
Ability to operate in ambiguity while building structure and clarity.
Excellent communication and synthesis skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with hybrid physical/digital systems

Compensation

The salary for this position has a range of USD 195,000 – USD 263,000 based on anticipated responsibilities, market benchmarks, and organizational constraints. LEGO Digital Play carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to prior experience, skills, expertise, location, internal equity, and other considerations permitted by law. The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Building on The Aerospace Corporation's reputation as a trusted, impartial advisor with integrity and dedication to mission success, the Civil Systems Group (CSG) combines deep technical expertise with market-leading innovation to help our customers solve complex systems engineering and integration challenges. CSG is organized by core customer-facing lines of business to manage and grow programs within NASA, NOAA, and the NNSA, while extending our capabilities to other civilian federal government agencies fully integrated within Aerospace rules, regulations, processes, values, and behaviors.

We are looking for an Enterprise Engineering Systems Director
(Systems Director – Systems and Digital Engineering)
. As a Systems Director in the Civil Systems Group within Defense, you will provide leadership, planning and direction to an experienced team of engineers and work closely with Engineering Technical Managers to support the mission area of the Department of Energy (DOE) National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) Office of Defense Programs (DP). You will lead and manage your team to accomplish systems engineering/analysis to various Defense Program tasks in support of our Nation. You will mentor your team to leverage Aerospace’s vast network of subject matter experts to bring innovative solutions to NNSA’s hardest problems. Additionally, you will look to identify new opportunities/challenges to leverage Aerospace capabilities to apply to our NNSA customer.

This is a full-time position based in Albuquerque, NM, Crystal City, VA, Colorado Springs, CO, or El Segundo, CA which requires a minimum of 4 days/week onsite work.

What You’ll Be Doing

Work closely with Principal Director and the rest of the management team to lead and manage Aerospace Enterprise Engineering team members with the challenging issues Aerospace is tackling for Defense Programs within the National Nuclear Security Administration.

🌊 About Sailor Health

America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. This shift will put unprecedented pressure on Medicare, which already spends more than $1 trillion each year caring for older adults. Yet the healthcare system is built backwards: reactive instead of preventative, measuring years of life instead of the quality of them.

Sailor Health is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. We partner with Medicare to make our platform affordable and accessible to older adults nationwide.

Sailor has exceptional product-market fit:

Exponential growth: We are honored to serve thousands of patients across all 50 states, with strong organic demand helping make Sailor one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare.
AI-powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.
Backed by category-defining founders: We are supported by founders from Ramp, Nourish, Headway, Charlie Health, and Spring Health.

⭐ About the Role

We're hiring a VP/Head of Engineering to lead technology and product at Sailor. You'll set technical direction, lead product across both our patient and provider platforms, and report directly to our CEO.

You'll be building at the frontier of AI and healthcare: our AI Health Coach that measurably improves health outcomes, copilots that give clinicians superpowers, and a longitudinal data platform spanning the full care journey. Just as exciting is the how, because you'll get gritty reinventing engineering practices for a world where AI changes how software gets built.

We're looking for a player-coach with high slope, someone who loves to build, and a leader wants to do the defining work of their career. On hiring, your mandate is to build the "Navy SEALs" of engineering: small by design, high-trust culture, and extremely talent dense.

💻 Your Key Responsibilities

Build! This is a player-coach role. You'll ship production code weekly and set the standard for what AI-native development looks like at Sailor.
Lead product. You'll own the roadmap across our patient and provider platforms - we expect you to deeply understand business problems & decisions.
Run experiments. You'll bring a data-oriented, experimentation-first mindset to a consumer product for a generation that's never had one built for them. Launch fast, read the signal, iterate.
Recruit. You'll attract and close exceptional engineers, drawing on your network and making Sailor the place the best builders want to be.
Set technical direction. You'll make the architecture calls as we scale, balancing speed today against the platform we'll need at ten times the patient volume.
Reinvent how we build. AI is changing what a small team can ship, and you'll push that frontier inside Sailor. You'll define the practices, tooling, and culture that let us outbuild much larger orgs.
Mentor the team. You'll mentor engineers across experience levels and turn strong builders into exceptional ones.

✅ What We're Looking For

This role isn't for everyone. It's fast-paced, chaotic, and requires hard work. But if this excites you, we'd love to meet you.

You've led engineering at a high growth startup: you thrived in the chaos, grew the team, set the engineering bar, and made the people around you better.
You're a builder. You've written meaningful production code in the last six months and have no interest in becoming a pure people manager.
You're a talent magnet. You've hired exceptional engineers from your own network, closed hard candidates, and some of them would follow you again.
You've owned product, not just executed it. You've made roadmap calls, written specs, and sat directly with users without a PM in between.
You're AI-native. AI is central to how you build software, and you can point to concrete changes in your team's workflow and output, well beyond autocomplete.
You stay on the frontier. You're on top of the newest models and eng tools, and you're usually the one bringing them to the team before anyone asks. We're TypeScript full stack, and you're at home in a modern web stack.
You're analytical and experimentation-first. You've launched features, read the data, and killed or doubled down accordingly.
You work hard. You're energized by intensity and want to be in person in NYC building a tight-knit team.

✚ Our Offer to You

💰 Top quartile salary and equity
🩺 Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental & vision insurance
🌴 Flexible PTO and sick days
🍱 Lunch and dinner in our beautiful Soho office covered by Sailor
🎤 Team building events
🕺🏻 Friendliest and most dynamic team culture
